defs.def: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, etc. 乡村；农村

ex.s: I tend to travel with a few of my friends to state parks or to the countryside to go on adventures and take photos along the way.
ex.t: 我倾向于和几个朋友去州立公园或乡村冒险，沿途拍照。

ex.s: By shooting in the countryside or state parks.
ex.t: 通过在乡村或州立公园拍摄。

ex.s: It will spread to the countryside.
Journey through the beautiful countryside of Provence，France，with Prof Ori Z.
ex.t: 与Ori Z教授一起穿越法国普罗旺斯美丽的乡村。

ex.s: During my last winter holiday, I went to countryside with my father to visit my grandparents.
ex.t: 去年寒假期间，我和父亲一起回乡下看望祖父母。

ex.s: A group of men are sent into the French countryside to try to find the fourth brother.
ex.t: 一群人被派到法国乡下去寻找第四个兄弟。

ex.s: It was as if our kindly countryside, close to the very heart of England, had been turned into a cruel grassland.
ex.t: 就好像我们那可爱的、紧挨着英格兰心脏地带的乡村，变成了一片残酷的草原。

ex.s: When reading The Road Not Taken, one cannot help but see in one’s mind images of a peaceful wood deep within the countryside.
ex.t: 读《未选择的路》时，人们不禁会在脑海中浮现出一片宁静的深林，坐落在乡村深处。

ex.s: Cusco Tour Enjoy the beautiful countryside as you spend a day driving along the new highway connecting Cusco to Lake Titicaca.
ex.t: 库斯科之旅：沿着连接库斯科和的的喀喀湖的新公路驱车一整天，欣赏美丽的乡村风光。

ex.s: The mountains, the sky, the lakes— the photos I’ve seen of China’s countryside are wonderful.
ex.t: 群山、天空、湖泊——我看到的中国乡村的照片太美了。
